title: Stones scanned this morning
description: John Stones goes for scans this morning, a day later than the papers first had it. Inter Women open their Champions League at Monza on Tuesday, and Davide Massa takes Roma–Inter on Saturday.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 16, Thursday, September 17, 2026 — Stones scanned today

blocks.html: John Stones goes for scans this morning, a day later than the papers first had it. Gazzetta dello Sport — Italy's biggest sports daily — fears about a month out. Inter Women open their Champions League at Monza on Tuesday, and a ticket can cost €1. Davide Massa takes Roma–Inter on Saturday.

blocks.h3: Inter Women open in Europe, and a ticket can cost €1
paras: Inter Women play their first match in the league phase of the Champions League on Tuesday, against BK Häcken of Sweden, at the Stadio Brianteo in Monza. Kickoff is 12:45 PM ET, 18:45 CEST.
Seats cost €10 in the Tribuna d'Onore and €5 in the Tribuna Ovest. Season-ticket holders, Inter Club members, under-18s and women pay €1.

Davide Massa referees Saturday's match at the Stadio Olimpico. Meli and Berti run the lines, Maresca is the fourth official, and Mazzoleni sits on VAR with Di Paolo beside him. The fifth-matchday appointments were made official on Wednesday.
Lega Serie A's own page would not load this morning. The team above is as Sky Sport Italia and Corriere dello Sport printed it.
blocks.kicker: SKY SPORT ITALIA · CORRIERE DELLO SPORT · SEP 16

paras: Kickoff at the Stadio Olimpico is 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST, on Saturday. Paramount+ has the match in the United States. In Italy the club says it is on DAZN and nowhere else.
John Stones has his scans on Thursday morning, not Wednesday. FCInter1908 reports that Inter left it a day on purpose, so the scan would read the damage clearly.
Gazzetta dello Sport describes a strain in the hamstring of his left thigh and fears about a month out. Either way he misses Saturday, and the international break covers part of it.
Edition No. 15 had Gazzetta expecting him back after the break. New today is the later scan date and a month as the fear.
blocks.kicker: UPDATE · GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTERNEWS · FCINTER1908 · SEP 16

blocks.h3: Çalhanoğlu's contract is the urgent one
paras: Hakan Çalhanoğlu's deal runs to June 30, 2027. Fabrizio Romano reports that Dario Baccin, Inter's sporting director, will sit down with the midfielder's agent Gordon Stipic shortly, and that the meeting is exploratory rather than a negotiation.
No figures are attached to it. Inter treat this as the most pressing contract on their desk.
